implementation_summary: Website Audit start screen. audit-start-form.ts: form state kept as text. Defaults come from validateAuditStartBody's normalised output for a bare address (200 pages, depth 8). The bounds are local constants (AUDIT_LIMIT_BOUNDS: pages 1-1000, depth 0-100, 50 paths) because CRAWL_LIMIT_BOUNDS is not on browser.js; a test pins each one against the validator. The client-side check uses validateAuditStartBody. audit-start-api.ts: submitAuditStart sends nothing when the check fails. startAudit POSTs to /api/audits and turns ERR_UNREACHABLE, ERR_PRIVATE_ADDRESS, ERR_INVALID_AUDIT (field messages go to their fields) and ERR_RUN_IN_PROGRESS into plain sentences. watchAudit follows /api/audits/:id/stream through an injectable EventSource factory, checks each event, ignores other audits and versions, and closes on done or failed. AuditProgress.tsx: stages with aria-current, a polite live region, counts for pages found, pages recorded and Skipped Pages, and done or stopped endings with no verdict wording. AuditStartScreen.tsx: labelled fields with hints, aria-describedby pointing to the hint and the error, aria-invalid, errors in role=alert, focus on the first field with an error, then progress after a 202. Correction applied: every @qa/types import in these files and their tests goes through @qa/types/src/browser.js (the T-211 guard), never the barrel or another module by path.

risks: AUDIT_LIMIT_BOUNDS copies the CRAWL_LIMIT_BOUNDS numbers locally. A test catches any drift from validateAuditStartBody. Re-exporting CRAWL_LIMIT_BOUNDS from browser.js (a types-owned change) would remove the copy.
The task packet and CLAUDE.md still say 'single modules'; the T-211 guard requires browser.js. The docs should be brought in line by whoever owns them.
ERR_INVALID_AUDIT replies that carry only a 'language' field message show only the general sentence, because this screen has no language field and always sends 'en'.
After a long stream drop the screen relies on the browser's own EventSource reconnect and does not fetch the audit's state again.
handoff: FE-191 should register AuditStartScreen (named export in packages/wizard/src/screens/audit/start/AuditStartScreen.tsx, no required props). Its optional props submit and openSource exist only for tests. The screen imports @qa/types only through @qa/types/src/browser.js. The 409 ERR_RUN_IN_PROGRESS sentence avoids the word 'run', which CONTEXT.md lists to avoid for Website Audit.
